about: Named spell combos: a recipe, what it does in plain words, and the check tests/content/spells/test_combos.gd runs on it in the test arena. Positions are pixels from the caster, who stands at (0, 0) and aims along +x. See docs/milestones/M2-spell-system.md, 'The combo catalogue'.

combos.name: Burning bolt
combos.does: A fire bolt; the imp keeps losing health after the hit.

combos.name: Shatter
combos.does: A frost bolt chills the imp, then a storm bolt on it sets off Shatter.

combos.name: Big fire ring
combos.does: One ring hits every imp within reach around the caster.

combos.name: Storm lance
combos.does: A ray through three imps in a line.

combos.name: Frost pulse rune
combos.does: A frost rune that pulses a frost nova every half second; imps standing round it freeze.

combos.name: Void ring
combos.does: Circling shots hex every imp that crosses the orbit.

combos.name: Homing fan
combos.does: Three homing bolts bend toward imps well off the aim, beyond what a plain fan of three reaches.

combos.name: Storm chain
combos.does: A hit jumps to the next imp, and that imp's shock makes the next hit jump once more.

combos.name: Blast at the end
combos.does: A fire blast where the bolt ends, with nothing in its way.

combos.name: Swift line
combos.does: A fast line through the room that hits every imp on it.

combos.name: Wide frost lane
combos.does: A wide ray that chills the imp in its lane.

combos.name: Fire fan orbit
combos.does: A ring that throws a fan of three fire bolts outward every half second.

combos.name: Hexed fire burst
combos.does: A void ring hexes the imps in front of you; each hexed imp bursts into a ring of fire that burns the imps beside it.

combos.name: Storm mine
combos.does: A storm rune on the floor; an imp that steps on it is hit, and the hit jumps on to the imps standing farther off.

combos.name: Frost then lightning ray
combos.does: A frost bolt's hit fires a storm ray onward from the target, through the imps behind it.

combos.name: Frost carousel
combos.does: A frost ring that goes through a packed crowd and chills nearly every imp it passes.

combos.name: Seeking void ray
combos.does: A ray that turns toward an imp a little off the aim and hexes it.

combos.name: Fire trap
combos.does: A fire rune waits on the floor and, when it ends, bursts into a ring of fire that burns the imps standing near it.

combos.name: Quick shock ring
combos.does: A quick ring of shock that flies farther and is ready again before a plain ring is (the second cast, at 0.8 s, is refused without Faster).

combos.name: Seeking frost burst
combos.does: A bolt that turns toward an imp, goes through it, and at the end of its flight bursts into frost on the imp waiting there.

combos.name: Storm on flame
combos.does: Two players: one sets an imp burning, the other's pulsing storm bolt sets off Flare on it.

combos.name: Static bolt
combos.does: A lightning bolt leaves the imp charged, ready to discharge on the next hit.

combos.name: Static ring
combos.does: A big lightning ring charges every imp round the caster.
